text: The granaries run thin. Your people whisper of empty bowls and hungry nights.
Famine grips the land. Children cry in the dark. The tribe faces ruin.
The granaries overflow. The tribe feasts beneath a harvest moon.
The old prayers fade. Your people begin to doubt the gods.
The tribe has abandoned the old ways. Silence fills the temple.
A wave of holy fervor sweeps the tribe. Your name is chanted at every hearth.
The tribe worships with undying zeal. Offerings burn day and night in your honor.
The tribe has grown into a great host. A new generation takes root.
The tribe spreads across the land. Villages rise where there were once only fires.
The tribe dwindles to a scattered few. Their songs grow quieter with each passing moon.
Only a remnant survives. The tribe's flame flickers on the edge of darkness.
Your divine power fades to a whisper. The mortal world grows heavy with silence.
Divine energy crackles through you. The heavens bend to your will.
